# Young Blue Dragon (`monsters:young-blue-dragon`)
*Large dragon, lawful evil* | **CR** 9 (XP 5,000; PB +4)
**AC** 18 | **HP** 152 (16d10 + 64) | **Speed** 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 80 ft.
**STR** 21 (+5) | **DEX** 10 (+0) | **CON** 19 (+4) | **INT** 14 (+2) | **WIS** 13 (+1) | **CHA** 17 (+3)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +4, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +5
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +9, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +4
**Damage Immunities:** lightning
**Senses:** Darkvision 120 ft., Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 19
**Languages:** Common, Draconic

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The dragon makes three Rend attacks.
- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.
- **Lightning Breath (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
